title: Residual Cross-Model Narrative Convergence under Shared Prompts: Auditing Prompt Controls and Narrative Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2611.34015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stories created by LLMs based on the same prompts can be narratively similar to one another. This similarity may reflect constraints imposed by the prompts as well as the models' writing tendencies. The current research analyzes 51,240 stories created by five models in the StoryScope corpus based on 10,248 common prompts. It uses 213 narrative features in seven dimensions to compare cross-model distances between stories generated from the same prompts with distances between stories generated from different but semantically matched prompts. To assess the relationship between narrative features and prompt content, a semantic relevance mask was evaluated against 420 author-annotated prompt-feature judgments (F1 = .813; near-threshold accuracy = .621). translated_title: 共享提示词下的残差跨模型叙事趋同：提示词控制与叙事测量的审计研究
translated_abstract: 基于相同提示词由大语言模型创作的故事在叙事上可能彼此相似。这种相似性既可能反映了提示词所施加的约束，也可能反映了模型自身的写作倾向。本研究分析了StoryScope语料库中五个模型基于10,248个共同提示词创作的51,240篇故事。研究使用七个维度的213项叙事特征，比较由相同提示词生成的故事之间的跨模型距离与由不同但语义匹配的提示词生成的故事之间的距离。为评估叙事特征与提示词内容之间的关系，研究针对420条由作者标注的提示词-特征判断对语义相关性掩码进行了评估（F1 = .813；临界准确率 = .621）。等权重平均残差趋同指数（RCI）在无掩码条件下为 .409，在有掩码条件下为 .406。这些发现表明，相对于……（原文摘要在此处截断），存在可测量的跨模型叙事趋同。
tldr: 本研究提出残差趋同指数（RCI≈0.41），通过比较相同提示词与语义匹配提示词下五个人工智能大模型生成故事的叙事距离，揭示了即便控制提示词内容后依然存在的可测量跨模型叙事趋同现象。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the Residual Convergence Index (RCI ≈ .41), revealing measurable cross-model narrative convergence among LLM-generated stories that persists even after controlling for prompt content through semantic masking.
